findings: An AX control can expose valid geometry without a semantic label. Native pointer geometry no longer requires the label used by semantic attestation. Existing click admission, pixel checks and approvals remain unchanged.
Scripted task preserves exact Unicode and all other bytes, saves once via the real approval continuation, rejects approval replay and returns cached completion without additional effects.

Holo trial02 inserts Zürich → 東京 immediately before Meeting notes, as independently visible in the retained image. Seattle remains. This is a model recovery error after an explicitly rejected click; the host correctly delivered the proposed insertion to the current selection.

The final Holo pointer diagnostic now retains the correct editor frame and matching authority, but target-region pixels differ. The exact changed pixels were not retained, so no particular source of repaint is proven.

Code inspection shows the 40-point padded target can extend outside the foreground window; caret blinking is another candidate. Capture bounded before/after differences and reproduce before changing the shared pixel policy.
All trial-owned TextEdit instances, model workers and credentials are removed. The installed host remains alive.
limits: One scripted real-app task and six focused methods pass; both actual Holo TextEdit tasks fail.
All bundles report a main-thread UI-unresponsiveness runtime warning without an identified call site; it remains unresolved. Existing unrelated compiler warnings remain.
Actual Holo uses the explicit diagnostic 5 GiB worker cap; worker peaks exceed the unchanged production 4 GiB limit. Whole-app 12 GB and heat remain unqualified.
The harness approves only one Save and up to three single clicks inside its current owned document editor; other approval forms need separate harness coverage.
This does not exercise full production host/client composition, real login, phone or cross-app operations.

status.accepted: Scoped geometry lookup and scripted real TextEdit workflow only; actual-model task and production acceptance remain open
